invariants.rationale: Ensures that the provided writeResult parameter is not null before any further operations are performed.
To safely operate on write statuses, they must be non-null when retrieving from writeResult.
All WriteStatus objects in the collection should be non-null to avoid NullPointerExceptions in downstream processing.
Each WriteStatus object should have non-null statistical information for accessing partition paths.
Partition path must be non-null for each status as it is used to partition data.
